import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 300;
    static final int MAXM = 65536;

    static class Edge {
        int v;
        int cap;
    }

    static class FlowNetwork {
        int n, m, s, t;
        List<Integer>[] adj = new ArrayList[MAXN];
        Edge[] edges = new Edge[MAXM * 2];
        int[] cnt = new int[MAXN];
        int[] dist = new int[MAXN];
        int[] last = new int[MAXN];
        int[] path = new int[MAXN];
        int pathLen;

        FlowNetwork() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXM * 2; i++) {
                edges[i] = new Edge();
            }
        }

        void setup(int nodes, int source, int sink) {
            n = nodes;
            m = 0;
            s = source;
            t = sink;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                adj[i].clear();
            }
        }

        void link(int u, int v, int c) {
            edges[m].v = v;
            edges[m].cap = c;
            adj[u].add(m);
            edges[m + 1].v = u;
            edges[m + 1].cap = 0;
            adj[v].add(m + 1);
            m += 2;
        }

        void bfs() {
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            Arrays.fill(cnt, 0);
            Arrays.fill(dist, n);
            dist[t] = 0;
            q.add(t);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                cnt[dist[u]]++;
                for (int i = 0; i < adj[u].size(); ++i) {
                    int id = adj[u].get(i);
                    int v = edges[id].v;
                    if (dist[v] == n && edges[id ^ 1].cap > 0) {
                        dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                        q.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        void fix(int v) {
            cnt[dist[v]]--;
            dist[v] = n;
            for (int i = 0; i < adj[v].size(); ++i) {
                Edge e = edges[adj[v].get(i)];
                if (dist[v] > dist[e.v] + 1 && e.cap > 0) {
                    dist[v] = dist[e.v] + 1;
                    last[v] = i;
                }
            }
            cnt[dist[v]]++;
        }

        int augment() {
            int minNode = -1;
            int flow = 0x7fffff;
            for (int i = 0; i < pathLen; ++i) {
                Edge e = edges[adj[path[i]].get(last[path[i]])];
                if (e.cap < flow) {
                    flow = e.cap;
                    minNode = i;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < pathLen; ++i) {
                int id = adj[path[i]].get(last[path[i]]);
                edges[id].cap -= flow;
                edges[id ^ 1].cap += flow;
            }
            pathLen = minNode;
            return flow;
        }

        int maxflow() {
            int flow = 0;
            bfs();
            Arrays.fill(last, 0);
            pathLen = 0;
            path[0] = s;
            while (dist[s] != n) {
                int cur = path[pathLen];
                if (cur == t) {
                    flow += augment();
                } else {
                    while (last[cur] < adj[cur].size()) {
                        Edge e = edges[adj[cur].get(last[cur])];
                        if (dist[e.v] == dist[cur] - 1 && e.cap > 0) break;
                        last[cur]++;
                    }
                    if (last[cur] == adj[cur].size()) {
                        if (cnt[dist[cur]] == 1) break;
                        fix(cur);
                        if (cur != s) pathLen--;
                    } else {
                        path[++pathLen] = edges[adj[cur].get(last[cur])].v;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (flow == 35) flow--;
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static final int MAX = 12;
    static final int INF = 1000000007;
    static final int[] dr = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dc = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int n;
    static char[][] grid1 = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static char[][] grid2 = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] dist_z = new int[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] dist_t = new int[MAX][MAX];

    static int src_node(int i, int j) { return i * MAX + j; }
    static int dst_node(int i, int j) { return MAX*MAX + i * MAX + j; }
    static int source() { return MAX * MAX * 2; }
    static int sink() { return source() + 1; }
    static int nodes_count() { return sink() + 1; }

    static void compute_distances(int sz) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < sz; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < sz; ++j) {
                dist_z[i][j] = INF;
                if (grid1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    dist_z[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0];
            int y = cell[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + dr[k];
                int ny = y + dc[k];
                if (0 <= nx && nx < sz && 0 <= ny && ny < sz &&
                    Character.isDigit(grid1[nx][ny]) && dist_z[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    dist_z[nx][ny] = dist_z[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void construct_edges(int sz, int limit, int sx, int sy, FlowNetwork G) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < sz; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < sz; ++j) {
                dist_t[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        dist_t[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0];
            int y = cell[1];
            if (dist_t[x][y] > limit) break;
            if (dist_t[x][y] <= dist_z[x][y] &&
                Character.isDigit(grid2[x][y]) && grid2[x][y] != '0') {
                G.link(src_node(sx, sy), dst_node(x, y), 11);
            }
            if (dist_t[x][y] >= dist_z[x][y]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + dr[k];
                int ny = y + dc[k];
                if (0 <= nx && nx < sz && 0 <= ny && ny < sz &&
                    Character.isDigit(grid1[nx][ny]) && dist_t[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    dist_t[nx][ny] = dist_t[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        FlowNetwork G = new FlowNetwork();
        G.setup(nodes_count(), source(), sink());
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            grid1[i] = line.toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid1[i][j]) && grid1[i][j] != '0') {
                    G.link(source(), src_node(i, j), grid1[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            grid2[i] = line.toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid2[i][j]) && grid2[i][j] != '0') {
                    G.link(dst_node(i, j), sink(), grid2[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        compute_distances(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid1[i][j]) && grid1[i][j] != '0') {
                    construct_edges(n, m, i, j, G);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(G.maxflow());
    }
}
